address: Fairmont Le Château Frontenac, 1 rue des Carrières, Québec, G1R 4P5, Canada
bio: Located on the ground floor of the iconic Château Frontenac, this restaurant boasts both history and charm. From tables in the sunroom, diners can drink in the breathtaking view of the city and the majestic St Lawrence River. As you enter, you see a huge glass cellar showcasing a selection of exceptional cheese, meat, and caviar. The Discovery set menu features modern dishes (bluefin tuna from the Gaspé Peninsula, berry dashi, plum; grilled lobster, corn mousse, marjoram), but you can also go à la carte. The wine list will dazzle even the most discerning of oenophiles....
